GIN.note: Mentions a state-approved hosting data centre only as a requirement; no data centre for hire is stated.
Arrêté sets retention and data subject rights for passenger data; no general data protection law, bill or authority is stated.
Article states nothing on a national ID system.
No nationally owned data centre for hire or state hosting in one is stated.
Possible BOT partnership is only not excluded; no amount is stated.
Article states nothing on a national standards body or national standards.

facts.fact: Arrêté A/2026/419/MT/CAB/SGG of 25 June 2026 requires Guinea's national API/PNR system to run in a state-approved data centre with security conforming to ISO/IEC 27001, per NewsAero.
